label: Object mapping / child mapping (Search)
type: a mapping nested inside a type mapping for a field that contains a JSON object. Static or dynamic like search:collection-mapping; can itself contain child field mappings.
evidence: Like Collection Mappings, object mappings can be static or dynamic. You can add Child Field Mappings to make an object mapping a static mapping.
Create a child mapping with the Couchbase Server Web Console to add or remove a field that contains a JSON object from a Search index.
relates_to_competency_question: Can a Search index mapping reach inside a nested JSON object field, or only top-level fields?
